programme.title: Pip og Poppy
programme.desc: Kaninen Pip og musen Poppy er meget forskellige - og allerbedste venner. De elsker at lege med hinanden, og når de leger, bliver det nærmest til små eventyr. Animeret serie bygget over børnebøgerne af Camilla Reid og Axel Scheffler, kendt fra Grøffeldyret.

programme.title: Bamselægen
programme.desc: Elly er kommet til Bamselægen, fordi hendes bamse Ninna har det rigtig dårligt. Den har feber og smerter, og Elly har lagt mærke til, at den har fået en lille bule på den ene side. Det viser sig, at den har en byld, som skal snittes åben, så betændelsen kan komme ud. Bagefter er Elly med Bamselægen på stuegang hos en bamse, der er indlagt med feberkramper. På vej hen til stuen med den indlagte bamse møder de Professor Allan, som fortæller, det ikke er farligt, men det kan godt se voldsomt ud med feberkramper.

programme.title: Hey Duggee - Egernklubben
programme.desc: Vi saknar beskrivning för denna sändning.

programme.title: Vida - dyrenes doktor
programme.desc: Canadisk animationsserie om Vida, som er en 10 år gammel syngende dyrlæge. Hun tager sig af dyrene, der bor omkring hende - en ræv med en forstuvet pote, en skildpadde med en kløende tå, en tiger med en øm tand - alle får hjælp af Vida, Dyrenes Doktor.

programme.title: Motor Mille og Børnebanden
programme.desc: Øverst i slottets tårn går den sure mand i gang med at smelte børnenes sutter om til engangsbestik. Motor Mille og Børnebanden lægger en snedig plan for at få sutterne tilbage - de skal bl.a. bruge1000 hoppebolde!

programme.title: F for Får
programme.desc: Frode Får - og ikke bondemanden - styrer løjerne på bondegården i denne fine britiske stop-motion-serie. Og det er ikke helt nemt, for dyrene på gården er en broget flok!

programme.title: Gurli Gris
programme.desc: Gurli er en elskelig, fræk lille gris, som bor sammen med sin lillebror Gustav, mor Gris og far Gris. Gurli elsker at lege, at klæde sig ud, at besøge spændende steder og at få nye venner, men hendes absolutte yndlingsbeskæftigelse er at hoppe rundt i mudder!

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Franske tegnefilm om den lille kanin Simon, der prøver kræfter med alt det, hverdagen byder på. Han møder verden med åbenhed, men også med sund skepsis og spirende selvstændighed. Bygget over en populær billedbogsserie af Stephanie Blake.

programme.title: Peter Plys
programme.desc: I ”Nye eventyr med Peter Plys” fører døren på Jakobs værelse ind i Hundredmeterskoven, et tidløst sted med spændende eventyr, forunderlighed og lune. Skabningerne, der bebor Jakobs verden, som Peter Plys, Tigerdyr, Grisling, Æsel, Max, Ugle, Kængu og Kængubarn, er skabt af hans fantasi. Deres vilde narrestreger er en spejling af Jakobs sprudlende, seksårige sind. Serien kombinerer masser af handling med en drengs kærlighed til sin bedste ven, en bjørn ved navn Peter Plys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey glæder sig til at komme hen til klatreringene og Far kører hende og Bingo til parken i trækvogn. Men hendes tålmodighed kommer på en prøve for Far stopper hele tiden og taler med andre voksne.

programme.title: Piratmusen Polly
programme.desc: Vi saknar beskrivning för denna sändning.

programme.title: Mission Valhalla
programme.desc: Brokks blæsebælg er borte! Bælgen, der blæser til ilden i dværgene Sindre og Brokks smedje. Det er ikke så godt, for Sindre og Brokk laver nogle af de bedste og vigtigste våben, guderne overhovedet har at forsvare sig med. De våben får de brug for, når de onde jætter en dag går til angreb, og ragnarok står for døren. Tordenguden Thor drager sammen med den modige, jordiske helt Emil ud for at skaffe blæsebælgen tilbage. For Valhalla!

programme.title: Leg med Dylan
programme.desc: Hvad skal Dylan være i dag? Pizzabud, læge eller frisør? - Dylan prøver det hele, og du lan lege med! Den stribede hund elsker at lege, og hver gang leger han, at han er noget nyt. Tegnefilmserie bygget over bøgerne af Guy Parker-Rees.

programme.title: John Dillermand
programme.desc: Det er juleaften og John skal bare lige købe et juletræ. Men på vejen møder han selveste julemanden, og pludselig skal John redde både julemanden, gaverne og ikke mindst sin egen juleaften.

programme.title: Oda Omvendt
programme.desc: Oda Omvendt samler børnene fra Sort Stue, for de vil have deres forældres fantasi tilbage - nu! Måske de endda også kan finde ud af, hvorfor Balder altid er så sur og tvær? Børnene har et hemmeligt trick i ærmet, og sammen er de stærkere end nogensinde før. Det får en forskrækket Balder snart at føle, og så bliver der fest i gaden på bedste Oda Omvendt-manér...

programme.title: Paddington på eventyr
programme.desc: Den elskelige bjørn Paddington bor hos familien Brown i London, men bylivet kan være lidt af en udfordring - heldigvis har han masser af gåpåmod, og hver dag byder på nye lærerige oplevelser.

programme.title: Galaktiske Ella
programme.desc: Et ægte rumeventyr med Galaktiske Ella. Hun er 8 år gammel - men helt vant til at tage på opdagelse på planeterne fra sin rumstation et sted mellem Mars og Jupiter.

programme.title: Mageløse Mille
programme.desc: Mageløse Mille er 8 år og vild med at opfinde ting og løse problemer - og med hjælp fra sine venner og sin fantasi klarer hun næsten alt på sin helt egen, kreative måde. Canadisk animationsserien bygget over en børnebogsserie af Ashley Spires.

programme.title: Dino-ranchen
programme.desc: Hvad ville du sige til at bo på en gård, hvor alle dyrene er dinosaurer? Besøg familien Cassidys ranch, hvor hver dag byder på nye eventyr, spænding og godt kammeratskab mellem Cassidy-børnene og deres dino'er. Canadisk animationsserie.

programme.title: Vilde Kræ
programme.desc: Tegnefilm med spænding, action og masser af vild viden om dyr og natur. Canadisk animationsserie man bliver klog af!

programme.title: Lille Nørd
programme.desc: Kan det virkelig passe, at papegøjer ikke kan lide at være alene? Ta' med Lille Nørd på papegøjejagt, og se om det lykkes Anders og Katrine at få papegøjen til at snakke.

programme.title: Vidundervovsen Vaffel
programme.desc: Sjov britisk serie om en familie og deres hund. Som alle hundeejere synes de selvfølgelig, at deres hund er helt speciel - men det er Vaffel faktisk også, for han kan tale, og det gør han - og det går ikke altid godt.

programme.title: Lånerne
programme.desc: De lever hemmeligt, inde i væggene - Lånerne. De låner vores ting, men ingen har nogensinde set en Låner - før nu, hvor vi følger den lillebitte Arietty og hendes familie på deres eventyr i den verden af kæmpemæssige farlige mennesker, de prøver at undgå. Men Arietty har alligevel venner blandt de få mennesker, der kan se hende....

programme.title: Jonahs dyreverden
programme.desc: Jonah elsker dyr mere end noget andet, og sammen med sin far rejser han ud og finder de sejeste - og mest skræmmende - dyr. Norsk dokumentarserie.

programme.title: Hvem lagde lorten?
programme.desc: Koen.

programme.title: Motor Mille og Børnebanden
programme.desc: Den Sure Mand på campingpladsen har taget alle børnenes legetøj for at få ro, og han har gravet det ned under sin campingvogn. Motor Mille og Børnebanden lægger en snedig og vild plan for at få legetøjet tilbage.

programme.title: Skæg med bogstaver
programme.desc: I dag besøger Hr. Skæg den fine restaurant Æ, hvor han lærer at lave en spændende ret. Han skal også have fat i en æske i gaveboden hos søde Persille, som bliver drillet af en fræk bogstav-stjælende mus. Hr. Skæg kan også både en dans og en sang med Æ.

programme.title: Byttebiksen
programme.desc: Rosa har byttet sig til en flot gave, og Lotte er ved at gå ud af sit gode skind for at åbne den. Desværre er der ingen der har fødselsdag. Heller ikke Ida Sofie, der snart skal være storesøster, Sigurd, der elsker at lege med sin vilde racerbane, eller Ronja, der gerne vil bytte en bamse væk.

programme.title: Mission Valhalla
programme.desc: Thors hammer er væk! Thors magiske hammer Mjølner, der måske er gudernes stærkeste våben i kampen mod de onde jætter. Det er ikke så godt, hvis Thor ikke har sin hammer, når dommedag måske er nær. Sammen med den modige, jordiske heltinde Hilde drager kærlighedsgudinden Freja ud for at skaffe Thors hammer tilbage. For Valhalla!

programme.title: Zig og Sharko
programme.desc: En klassisk slapstick-animationsserie uden ord i bedste 'Hjulben og Ulven'-stil. Den evigt sultne hyæne Zig finder på mere og mere sindrige planer for at fange og spise den søde havfrue Marina, men heldigvis er havfruens bedste ven, en haj ved navn Sharko, god til at afværge hyænens planer. Og det er lige opfindsomt, voldeligt og super sjovt hver gang!

programme.title: Mini-Agenterne
programme.desc: Der er blevet lavet hærværk på et festlokale. Nogen ser ud til at ville ødelægge det for fødselsdagsbarnet. Men hvem og hvorfor? Svaret får vi forhåbentlig, når Mini-Agenterne får løst mysteriet.

programme.title: Sprinter Galore
programme.desc: Lillesøster skal døbes, og familien har styr på alt til barnedåben - lige bortset fra navnet, for hvad skal hun hedde? Sprinter er heller aldrig blevet døbt, siger han, men det kan Magnus da bare ordne - de låner bare lige lillesøsters dåbskjole og en haveslange. Det kan der vel ikke ske noget ved ... ?

programme.title: Sprinter Galore
programme.desc: Der er udklædningsdag i Magnus' klasse, og Sprinter ser det som en oplagt mulighed for at snige sig med i skole - på en måde er han jo klædt ud i forvejen og vil ikke vække opsigt. Men ægte superheltekræfter er åbenbart sværere at skjule end som så ...

programme.title: Æblerup
programme.desc: Legetøjsbutikken i Æblerup har fået en vandskade og er lukket, så børnene begynder at lege med dyrelegetøj i stedet. Alle kæledyrene føler sig overset og bliver sure over, at børnene tager deres ting - så sure, at de planlægger et stort opgør mod børnene.

programme.title: Æblerup
programme.desc: Et ordentligt gok i nødden forandrer Hr. Cement, så han bliver helt rar. Han beslutter sig for at producere noget, der er bedre end cement - nemlig vitaminpiller til alle børnene! Men pillerne er kæmpestore og svære at sluge. Kan Trafalgar og Pulver mon få Hr. Cement tilbage til sit gamle jeg?

Den skal indlægges og have lagt et drop for på den måde at få noget væske ind i kroppen. For at det ikke skal gøre ondt at få lagt droppet, giver de den noget tryllecreme på. Men det er svært at sige farvel til en ven, der har boet så længe både i ens underkøje og i ens hjerte ...

programme.title: Sprinter Galore

programme.title: FailArmy Fail Family
programme.desc: FailArmy celebrates all the weird uncles, estrange cousin and black sheep that make getting together for the holidays such a trip.

programme.title: Best Fails of the Month
programme.desc: The best of the worst for April '26.

programme.title: Best Fails of the Month
programme.desc: The best of the worst for May '26.

programme.title: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Chiana finds a recording with Moya's prior Pilot. Pilot orders Aeryn to leave after realizing she was there.

programme.title: Picture If You Will
programme.desc: Chiana buys a picture which is more than it seems. The picture shows Chiana what will happen to her.

programme.title: Home On The Remains
programme.desc: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn can tolerate the spores.

programme.title: Dream A Little Dream
programme.desc: After the Gammak base is destroyed, Zhaan is on trial for murder. Chiana and Rygel act as her defense lawyers.

programme.title: Out Of Their Minds
programme.desc: An alien ship fires a weapon at Moya. The blast causes everyone's consciousness to jump into another body.

programme.title: My Three Crichtons
programme.desc: Crichton is cloned into a version who is a de-evolved 'cave man' and another who has increased mental ability.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
programme.desc: Princess Katralla, cannot ascend unless she finds a mate genetically compatible to her poisoned DNA.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programme.desc: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton faces 80 years as a statue. The Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into acid.

programme.title: Beware Of Dog
programme.desc: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.

programme.title: Won't Get Fooled Again
programme.desc: Crichton returns to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth? Is this some trick, if so who is behind it and why.

programme.title: The Locket
programme.desc: A time distortion traps Aeryn and John to live out the rest of their lives. On Moya it's only a few hours.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.

programme.title: A Clockwork Nebari
programme.desc: A Nebari group come aboard Moya and attempt to mind cleanse everyone using a drug.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money: Part 1, A Not So Simple Plan
programme.desc: Stark helps the crew with a plan to steal money from a depository to free D'Argo's son, Jothee, from slavery.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money: Part 2, With Friends Like These
programme.desc: With the loot from the Depository heist at hand, D'Argo waits to make contact with the Slave Traders.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
programme.desc: The crew breaks into the depository to free Crichton with the help of Talyn's unexpected arrival.

programme.title: Die Me, Dichotomy
programme.desc: The crew meets with a famous surgeon whom they hope can heal Moya's burns and remove Crichton's neural chip.

programme.title: Season Of Death
programme.desc: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, while Scorpius tries to avoid discovery. Zhaan makes a personal sacrifice.

programme.title: Suns And Lovers
programme.desc: Moya docks at a commerce station. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.desc: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.desc: The crew escapes the other ship and wormhole. Things are complicated when their new 'friends' sabotage Moya.

programme.title: Different Destinations
programme.desc: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool back in time where they alter the timeline.

programme.title: Eat Me
programme.desc: Crichton lands his transport pod on a dying leviathan full of cannibals and a scientist who can create clones.

programme.title: Thanks For Sharing
programme.desc: Moya rendezvous with Talyn who is seriously hurt. D'Argo and Rygel try to find Clorium, a drug to help Talyn.

programme.title: Green Eyed Monster
programme.desc: Talyn is swallowed by a boodong, leaving Stark and Rygel stranded in a transport pod.

programme.title: Losing Time
programme.desc: Moya's crew starts blacking out and missing portions of time. Pilot becomes inhabited by another entity.

programme.title: Relativity
programme.desc: Talyn lands on a planet covered with healing plants. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship to find Xhalax.

programme.title: Incubator
programme.desc: Scorpius puts the neural chip into his own brain in an attempt to retrieve vital wormhole equations from Crichton.

programme.title: Meltdown
programme.desc: Talyn wants to fly into a sun. While near it Stark is contacted by an alien woman being held against her will.

programme.title: Scratch N Sniff
programme.desc: Pilot forces Crichton, D'Argo, Jool and Chiana to take a holiday as he is fed up with their bickering.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.desc: Crichton must seek out an old friend who has gained too much knowledge about wormholes.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.desc: Jack unlocks Crichton's wormhole knowledge so they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.

programme.title: Revenging Angel
programme.desc: D'Argo injures Crichton, as Crichton lies in a coma/near death, he escapes into a highly animated world.

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aeryn leaves to grieve on a planet. She spots someone who might be her father but not all reunions are happy.

programme.title: Fractures
programme.desc: Escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have returned from Talyn.

programme.title: I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programme.desc: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.desc: The crew must stop Scorpius's research. They must board the command carrier and destroy it from within.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.

programme.title: Dog With Two Bones
programme.desc: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground. D'Argo destroys a Leviathan that attacks other ships.

programme.title: Crichton Kicks
programme.desc: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew discovers Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks. They must stop the magnetic storm on Arnesk.

programme.title: Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.desc: The crew is enroute to meet with Moya. They eat Noranti's concoction and raiders entomb Rygel in amber.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Everyone reunites on Moya. Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims he saved the former Peacekeeper's life.

programme.title: Natural Election
programme.desc: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

programme.title: John Quixote
programme.desc: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.

programme.title: I Shrink Therefore I Am
programme.desc: When Moya is raided by Peacekeeper bounty hunters, everyone is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.

programme.title: A Prefect Murder
programme.desc: While Moya's crew are resupplying on a xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect.

programme.title: Coup By Clam
programme.desc: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. But if not ingested by the same person, it becomes deadly.

programme.title: Unrealized Reality
programme.desc: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.

programme.title: Kansas
programme.desc: Crichton accidentally alters the past, causing his dad to fly on the doomed shuttle 'Challenger'.

programme.title: Terra Firma
programme.desc: Crichton has arrived home. Although the crew relaxes, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.

programme.title: Twice Shy
programme.desc: Moya takes on a new passenger, but she is an alien in disguise, intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.

programme.title: Mental As Anything
programme.desc: The crew's males undergo training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes, D'Argo learns self control.

programme.title: Bringing Home The Beacon
programme.desc: The women of Moya travel to a dead Leviathan to buy a sensor beacon that will allow Moya to camouflage.

programme.title: A Constellation Of Doubt
programme.desc: John Crichton struggles to learn the location of the mysterious Katratzi, whilst watching a tv documentary.

programme.title: Prayer
programme.desc: Crichton and Scorpius travel to one of the 'unrealized realities'. Aeryn resists torture on a Scarran ship.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction
programme.desc: The crew goes after Aeryn on a Scarran controlled station.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programme.desc: Moya arrives at Katratzi. Crichton attends peace talks between Scarrans and Peacekeepers with a nuclear bomb.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programme.desc: Scorpius has betrayed the crew. Now they're all captured. The plan failed so the crew must help Scorpius.

programme.title: Bad Timing
programme.desc: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans travel through a wormhole to Earth, where those flowers grow.

programme.title: Bad Timing
programme.desc: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans travel through a wormhole to Earth, where those flowers grow.

programme.title: Premiere
programme.desc: Astronaut John Crichton is sucked through a wormhole into a distant part of the universe.

programme.title: Exodus From Genesis
programme.desc: A locator beacon on Moya is automatically broadcasting its exact location to Peacekeeper forces in the area.

programme.title: Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.desc: The crew rescues a scientist and his assistant from a disintegrating ship.

programme.title: Throne For A Loss
programme.desc: Rygel is captured by bounty hunters. He stole a crystal from Moya and she will crash if it isn't returned.

programme.title: PK Tech Girl
programme.desc: The crew finds the Zelbinion battleship. They work to get the shield functional before it's attacked again.

programme.title: Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.desc: The crew visits a planet of happy workers. Rygel's fluids become explosive. Aeryn and Pilot must learn why.

programme.title: I, E.T.
programme.desc: A peacekeeper beacon goes off and Moya has to land on an alien planet to prevent its signal being intercepted and Moya being discovered.

programme.title: That Old Black Magic
programme.desc: Crichton and Crais's spirits are captured by Maldis, who thrives on hate. Zhaan takes a dark path to fight.

programme.title: DNA Mad Scientist
programme.desc: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew and promises to use it to find their home planets.

programme.title: They've Got A Secret
programme.desc: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute and gets ejected into open space.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What on earth and/or sea is super fun host Kim Lallouz cooking this week for her One Big Recipe? You guessed it - Surf and Turf! 'Turf's up' next with a fresh off-the-hoof Marrow Toast plate decked out with melty marrow, crispy crostini, and garlicky parsley salad. programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home. The Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons. Customers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service. The owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others. Working with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The truck, which started as a one-woman operation, quickly gained traction and now sees massive crowds, even requiring early gate openings for events like the Foo Fighters' performance. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.desc: S1 E4Teamet undersöker en hemlig u-båtsstation som skulle kunna ha hjläpt Hitlers flykt från Europa. Man hittar också en sjunken u-båt nära Caleta de Loros.

programme.title: Digging For The Truth
programme.desc: S2 E6 — The Real Temple of DoomTusentals år innan inkafolket styrde över den plats som nu kallas Peru dominerades regionen av en märklig och unik civilisation. Denna kallades Chavin, och berättelsen om den är en av historiens märkligaste.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: S6 E2 — The Crystal SkullsÄr kristallskallarna en invecklad bluff? Eller besitter de stor, kanske till och med utomjordisk, kraft? Avsnittet granskar de mest kontroversiella av forntidens artefakter.

programme.title: MonsterQuest
programme.desc: S3 E24 — The Real Moby DickI århundraden har det berättats om enorma, aggressiva späckhuggare. De förevigades i romanen "Moby Dick". Dessa berättelser handlade om valar som siktade in sig på fartyg och rammade dem med sina enorma huvuden. Kan berättelser som dessa vara sanna?

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: S1 E2 — USOsÅr 1990 fick en pilot som flög sitt lilla plan utanför Catalina Island syn på ett föremål under vattenytan som svepte in hans plan i ett starkt ljus och fick instrumenten att haka upp sig.

programme.title: Missing In Alaska
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Attack of the Ice GnomesIakttagelser av små djur har sammanfallit med rapporter om försvunna personer i Alaskatriangeln. Strövar människoätande gnomer runt i Alaska?

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: S2 E6Mörk materia och mörk energi utgör 96 % av universum. Fenomenen upptäcktes för bara tio år sedan och forskarna har svårt att förstå deras ovanliga egenskaper och besvara den slutgiltiga frågan: Hur ser ödet ut för vårt universum?

programme.desc: Emisija 7plus je dijaloška emisija Hayata TV. U polusatnom formatu, sa relevantnim gostima iz zemlje, regije i svijeta, analizirimo najaktuelnije teme i događaje.

programme.title: Bošnjaci
programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal Bošnjaci je prvi projekt takve vrste čiji je cilj da u nekoliko epizoda, trajanja 30-40 minuta, odgovori na ključna pitanja i rasvijetli najznačajnije trenutke u historiji Bošnjaka. Sagovornike (historičare, filozofe, politologe, radnike iz oblasti kulture) odabrali smo tako da mogu, shodno svojim uskim poljima djelovanja, odgovoriti na pitanja u vezi s različitim periodima historije bošnjačkog naroda i različitim segmentima njegovog društvenog, političkog i kulturnog razvoja. Cilj projekta jeste ponuditi televizijsku formu koja će primarno biti dokument za učenje, ali i osvještavanje pozicije Bošnjaka u geopolitici prošlih vremena, ali i savremenog doba. To nastojimo postići davanjem informacija i historijskih činjenica zabilježenih u našoj i svjetskoj literaturi i dokumentima, ali prevashodno kroz razgovore s naučnicima koji mogu, sada i u ovakvoj formi, podijeliti dio svog znanja.

programme.title: BH gradovi - Sarajevo
programme.desc: Rijetke su zemlje koje se, poput BiH, mogu pohvaliti tako raznovrsnim kulturno-historijskim blagom. Njeni gradovi, svaki za sebe, kriju tajne koje s velikom pažnjom privlače brojne strane i domaće posjetioce. Šetnjom kroz bh. gradove otkrivamo vam samo djelić neprocjenjivih ljepota.

programme.desc: Papa Franjo neprestano poziva vjernike da, poput Isusa, budu blizu bolesnicima i umirućima. Da im pruže ruku, ohrabre, utješe, pomognu. Isus je svoju blizinu potrebitima iskazivao tijekom cijelog svog javnog djelovanja i zato je jedno od temeljnih poslanja Crkve od samih njezinih početaka - briga za bolesne i umiruće. O pastoralu bolesnika, patnji i svojim iskustvima suočavanja s teškim bolestima govore gosti emisije primarijus dr. sc. Ružica Šmalcelj, dr. med. i vlč. Ivan Lastovčić, župnik župe sv. Ivana Krstitelja u Zagrebu.

programme.title: Kod Nas Doma
programme.desc: Nova pjesma Mile Kekina zove se Marko nogomet, ali nema baš mnogo veze ni s Markom ni s nogometom. Ima zato s mobitelima, tajnama koje u njima čuvamo i našom kreativnošću kada nešto želimo sakriti. Što se krije iza neobičnog naslova, ali i što nam još glazbeno sprema, otkrit će nam Mile Kekin!Kako tinejdžeru koji živi uz mobitel, streaming i društvene mreže reći: Slušaj ovo! i pritom mu pustiti Čajkovskog, Ravela ili Chopina? Upravo to pokušava novi glazbeno-scenski projekt HRT-a i Lisinskog. S nama su redatelj Krešimir Dolenčić te braća, glumac Jan Kovačić i skladatelj Vigo Kovačić!Tko će nakon grupe LELEK dobiti priliku predstavljati Hrvatsku na Eurosongu, još ne znamo, ali potraga je službeno počela! Otvoren je natječaj za Doru 2027., a što trebaju znati oni koji već imaju pjesmu, ili je tek trebaju dovršiti, otkrit će nam voditelj projekta Dora Tomislav Štengl!

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja te istodobno grade taktiku koja će ih dovesti do finalnog kruga. Međutim, na putu im stoji lovac. Taj će ih (ne)uobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušati jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i ispratiti ih kući praznih ruku.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - Smart Investment
programme.desc: An amazing beachfront property is what Inez’s couple is looking for And these top million dollar agents are sure to surpass their expectations.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - SCOTLAND And SWITZERLAND
programme.desc: It’s a royal theme in part one as we stay in the royal mile of Edinburgh in Scotland in the famous Balmoral Hotel now owned by Rocco Forte. In Switzerland we discover the lake based city of Geneva with its famous landmark the Jet d’Eau.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - FRANCE
programme.desc: In Paris we visit Hotel le Meurice and Hotel Plaza Athenee, then head down south to sunny Cannes and stay in the Carlton made famous of course by Elton John.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - Philippines/ Maldives Special
programme.desc: Elise Ducan showcases Philippine's best resorts in El Nido Palawan; to continue on the theme of luxury travel, she heads to Maldives to explore 2 of the finest properties there; Shangri La and COMO Maalifushi

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S2 - Borneo
programme.desc: Scotty gets in touch with his ancestral roots and David get's a new friend in Borneo.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S4 - South Africa, Fiji
programme.desc: Scotty is in beautiful South Africa, searching for the Big 5. Carolyne explores the wonderful ancient city of Rome. Lynton heads to the hills of Fiji and is rewarded with an amazing surprise. And Susannah is in the Big Apple, New York.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - Ulagala, Sri Lanka - Florence
programme.desc: From Michael Angelo’s David in Florence to elephant safaris in Sri Lanka, this is an art lovers and outdoorsy adventure.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - Algarve And Parrot Cay (Turks And Caicos Islands)
programme.desc: From miles of soft golden sand in Portugal’s Algarve region, to the miles of sand that surrounds Parrot Cay Island in the Turks and Caicos, this is a beach lover’s episode.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S1 - Vienna
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to the home of the Christmas market, Vienna, to get to the bottom of what makes them so special, checking out great festive food, fascinating traditions and warming drinks!

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S1 - Rome
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to the Italian Capital, Rome, for a Weekend Break. Over the course of 3 days he eats amazing local dishes, tours the sights – both by foot and by scooter - and even tries his hand as a Gladiator.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S1 - Barcelona
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to Barcelona for a Weekend Break. Over the course of 3 days he tries incredible local food and drink and gets involved with local customs in a city where there always seems to be a party to join!

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S6 - Little Rock
programme.desc: In this episode, Denella visits Little Rock, Arkansas, Arkansas's capital city.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S6 - Boston
programme.desc: In this episode, Denella visits Boston, Massachusetts.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S6 - Milwaukee
programme.desc: Denella experiences Milwaukee–where fresh meets fearless every day.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - Land of the Rising Sun
programme.desc: Dive into the neon streets of Tokyo, Japan. Explore the sights and culture of the world's most populous city to see what makes it so magnetic.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - Aloha Hawaii
programme.desc: Catch a wave in the Aloha State. Tour the four biggest islands, from the surfing mecca of the North Shore to the cinematic jungles of Kauai.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - Ten of the Coolest Places on Earth
programme.desc: Look back at the most memorable destinations of the season, from the depths of the Great Barrier Reef to the top of the Empire State Building.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - ITALY And FRANCE
programme.desc: This time we visit Milan the home of fashion. In part two we are all at sea, well more on river to be truthful in beautiful Burgandy in the wine region of France.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - CAPE TOWN And BLUE MOUNTAINS
programme.desc: In the episode we visit the Mother City of South Africa – Cape Town. The second half of the show is based in the distinctive blue haze of the Blue Mountains, Australia.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - BANGKOK And NEW YORK
programme.desc: We visit floating Markets, Royal Palaces and the new spa and sauna of the Peninsula Hotel in Bangkok. Then it’s off to the city that's so good they named it twice… New York!

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - Ranch Life - Texas
programme.desc: Sometimes exploring the road less traveled gives you the biggest adventure. In this episode, we escape the city buzz and opt for a quieter life on a Texas ranch. Taking time to appreciate the beauty in history, animals and quality time as a family.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - Luxury With Purpose - Belize
programme.desc: Join us on an epic adventure to a remote private island in Belize. As we spend our days catching lobsters, diving the worldclass reef and enjoying coconuts straight from the tree. We also learn about how much our tourism dollars really count.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - Daring Dive into Conservation - Fiji
programme.desc: We travel to an island resort in Fiji known for it’s daring shark encounters! To hear and see first hand the amazing conservation work they’re doing. Along the way we meet the local school kids and learn about how they’re helping protect the reef.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - Algarve V Istanbul
programme.desc: Portugal’s Algarve has long been a favorite holiday destination in Europe. Gill takes a boat ride along the regions famous sea cave coastline. While Richard enjoys a tour around the Turkish city of Istanbul, and visits the jewel in the cities crown.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - Toledo Spain V Provo (Turks And Caicos)
programme.desc: Gill throws everything she’s got into this episode in her Spanish safari from the countryside town of Toledo, seventy kilometers south of Madrid. Richard visits the tiny island of Providenciales, part of the Turks and Caicos Islands in the Caribbean.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - Lisbon V Parrot Cay (Turks And Caicos)
programme.desc: In the penultimate episode Richard remains in the Turks and Caicos Islands, only this time he’s visiting the exclusive island resort of Parrot Cay. While Gill’s combining a city and beach break in the Portuguese capital of Lisbon.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S4 - Sorrento, Denarau
programme.desc: Carolyne explores the gorgeous town of Sorrento, Italy. Scotty continues his trip in South Africa and samples some of the local delicacies. Lynton makes a splash in Denarau, Fiji. And Susannah wraps up her discovery tour of New York.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S4 - Florence, Los Angeles
programme.desc: Lynton explores the iconic Coral Coast of Fiji. Carolyne visits the wonders of Florence. Scotty continues his journey through South Africa and Susannah discovers a slightly more sinister side of Los Angeles.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S4 - Athens, Tokyo
programme.desc: Scotty wraps up his South African adventure with a visit to the Cape. Carolyne goes on a sojourn around Greece’s capital, Athens. Susannah explores one of LA’s unusual hot spots. Scotty ticks off one of his life-long bucket lists, Tokyo Japan.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - The Land of Rudyard Kipling: Kanha And Bandhavgarh National Parks
programme.desc: With classic tales as The Jungle Book to his credit, Rudyard Kipling brought India to life for many readers around the world. In this episode, Bill steps back into Kipling’s wild world while exploring Kanha and Bandhavgarh National Parks.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - Bangalore and Ooty
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - Mumbai And Goa
programme.desc: Join us as we explore the Gateway to India—Mumbai. From its early history, it’s many foreign occupations to the hustle and bustle of today. Bill tells Mumbai’s rich history is told through two of its most famous inhabitants, Gandhi and Kipling.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - Bali
programme.desc: The Luxe Travels season starts off in the beautiful and highly popular tourism hotspot; Bali. The host, Liesel Hlista embarks on a mission to understand how the Balinese blend hospitality with luxury.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - Ireland
programme.desc: An uncommon destination for a series that explores exotic tropical getaways. But this island nation has some of the most evocative landscapes that mother nature has to offer!

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - Jamaica
programme.desc: Easy island vibes, lots of amazing local rum, brilliant natural landscapes and those amazing beaches! Of course,Luxe Travels is in Jamaica! But in this episode, host Liesel Hlista shows you a different side of the Irie nation; away from the hordes of people unleashed via cruise liners!

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - Even More of the Coolest Endurance Races
programme.desc: Travel to the world's wildest endurance challenges, from the freezing Polar Circle tundra to Chile's most active volcano.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - Coolest Caves, Vistas, and Natural Wonders
programme.desc: Climb into the planet's deepest caves, take in beautiful vistas, and witness dazzling natural phenomena across the globe

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - Coolest Buildings, Public Art, and Public Parks
programme.desc: Tour the world's tallest buildings, view incredible public art installations, and explore Singapore's dazzling treetop parks.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - South Korea - Traditional
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is in South Korea, where he visits Taekwondo group, the K Tigers, a tarot card reader and reveals the secret to the perfect card shuffle.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - Racing a Million Devotees
programme.desc: Jonathan gets the classic train experience acclimating to bizarre washroom customs and the diversity of society rolling down the tracks. Glory, salvation and madness ensue when the master of the universe emerges from his temple.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - Cruising the City of Joy
programme.desc: Our host dives deep into the rich stew of colonial legacies and neighborhood traditions

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - Mediterranean Scuba
programme.desc: A British family faces local resistance while opening a business in the Spanish desert. Scuba divers search for a century-old wreck. A French townhouse begins its transformation.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - The Boss
programme.desc: An expat adjusts to working with her husband after 34 years of teaching. A scuba business considers relocating to the UK. Bar owners in Spain's desert face their busiest night.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - A Seller's Market
programme.desc: Young professionals Martin And Helena face up to the complexities of the Christchurch housing market and South Aucklanders Shandel and Steven battle spiralling prices as they search for a family home.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - Rollercoaster Ride
programme.desc: Blenheim schoolteachers Joanna and Chris begin a rollercoaster ride to home ownership and in South Auckland, locals Shandel and Steven take on the investors in their quest to secure a family home.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - The Journey Begins
programme.desc: Overcoming illness and the chaos of bustling Chennai city traffic, Jess rides with a diverse group through vibrant coastal towns, before venturing inland toward the mountains and the sacred town of Palani.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - Houston
programme.desc: Jamie Hancock was raised in Houston’s South Park area, a place notorious for gang violence, but also where hip hop artists created a new sound. Today, a new positive message is being created by people like Jamie through music.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - Te Matau-a-Māui
programme.desc: Piri and ex Māori All Black Shannon Paku are in Te Matau-a-Māui (Hawkes Bay). They’re hosted by Rob Beard of Beard Brothers Sausages, targeting Koura and Gurnard. They also visit Piri’s old stomping grounds of Te Aute College with ex-classmate Tautoko Ratu.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - Whakatāne
programme.desc: Piri and ex Crusader Tu Umaga-Marshall are in Whakatane. Hosted by Henare Ruru and Henare Rangitaawa of The Dive Squad, they target Haku (Kingfish), give tips and tricks to the Taneatua and Paroa Rugby Clubs and go on a Boar hunt with Troy Petersen.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - Waikawa
programme.desc: Piri and ex Warrior Paul Whatuira are in Waikawa (Picton), diving and gathering kai for the local Kaumatua, trying for a day time Tuna (Eel) with Shannon’s son Malone and having a run around at the Motueka Rugby Club.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S3 - Hawkes Bay
programme.desc: Padre takes Piri to the river mouth fishing for kahawai. Plus we follow the dugs in search of wild pigs.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - Las Vegas
programme.desc: Las Vegas is home to a hot rod car club community which over the decades has been connected to the rise of rockabilly music. Through Luke Metz and his band, Shanda And The Howlers, we learn how this bond between fashion, music and cars was created.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - Royalty in Robertson
programme.desc: While Xander and his team experience the lush, green valleys and incredible vineyards in Robertson, Adam learns a tough lesson about not only surviving, but thriving.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - Historical Swellendam
programme.desc: While Xavier works with a professional South African stunt performer to go mountain biking and kayaking, Adam endeavors to complete a stunt of his own.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - On the Edge in Gans Bay
programme.desc: While Xander travels to the fishing town of Gansbaai to experience the joys, and horrors, of the sea, Adam experiences a few frights of his own back at home.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - Barentsburg
programme.desc: Local Exploring on the edge of the world as Josh is on the artic Svalbard archipelago to explore in and around Barentsburg and the Arctic Ocean.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - Tirana
programme.desc: From Tirana, capital of old Soviet satellite Albania, Josh starts another local adventure filled with bunkers, a hidden hospital and diving in a pirate’s cave.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - Lüderitz
programme.desc: Epic Exploring is going local again as Cody adventures in Lüderitz, Namibia going off the beaten path, through the desert and on to the ghost town of Pamona.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - Canada’s Sunshine Coast, BC
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to British Columbia’s beautiful Sunshine Coast, to explore the 112-mile long Sunshine Coast Trail and to test his nerves at the Coast Gravity Downhill Mountain Bike Park.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - Peak District And Derbyshire
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to the Peak District in England, to tackle the 268-mile Pennine Way—Britain’s oldest and most challenging National Trail.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - Juneau, Alaska
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads deep into the backcountry to explore the mountains, glaciers and wildlife around Alaska’s capital city of Juneau.

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - Marriage Highs
programme.desc: Tayler and Jason reconnect during a romantic stay in Lake Tahoe, but Jason struggles keeping his cool while off roading the Rubicon Trail. Are Jason's high expectations too? And will these expectations shut them down on their next climb, Mt Whitney?

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - Alpenglow
programme.desc: Jason and Tayler attempt to summit the highest peak in the continental US, Mt Whitney. However, during their time on ascent they run into some unexpected surprises that leave this mountain attempt one they will never forget.

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - One More Round
programme.desc: A relaxing trip to Orcas Island takes a turn for the worst when plans begin to fall through; including the ferry ride back to the mainland. This mishap may leave them stranded for longer than expected, putting their final summit attempt at risk.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - Delhi to Manali
programme.desc: On the verge of an epic roadtrip, Jonathan visits the shrine of the motorcycle God for providence and sidetracks to combat the all-woman unit of the Delhi police.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - Ladakh, the Mountain Adventure
programme.desc: Jonathan embarks on a two wheeled journey over the highest roads in the world, stopping in remote monasteries to learn the secrets of Buddhism’s warrior demons and track down a secreted manuscript rumored to explain the lost years of Jesus.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - Thailand: World War II Secrets
programme.desc: Jonathan explores hidden bunkers, stashed warplanes, and forgotten memorials to uncover Thailand's suppressed World War II history.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - Indonesia: The Java Coffee Quest
programme.desc: Jonathan traces Java's colonial coffee roots, explores mysterious temples, and joins the Jakarta Fire Department for a trial by fire.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - Indonesia to India: Capitals and Currents
programme.desc: Jonathan examines Indonesia's massive capital relocation before following a spiritual quest centered on sacred water all the way to India.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - India: Secrets of the Deep South
programme.desc: Venture off the beaten path into southern India as Jonathan investigates the origins of mysterious temples and untold regional histories.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - India: Chasing the Ramayana
programme.desc: Riding a Royal Enfield, Jonathan retraces the epic Ramayana through crocodile habitats and sunken temples to the edge of the subcontinent.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - Day 1
programme.desc: Kevin travels to Switzerland and has 24 hours to go from Zurich to the Swiss mountains, while Jalou finds an exciting way to go from Cannes to Corsica.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - Day 2
programme.desc: Jalou has 24 hours to get from Barcelona to Tarragona where she conquers the Catalonian mountains with her mountain bike. Kevin tries to beat her in Slovenia.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - Day 3
programme.desc: Kevin leaves civilization behind in Suriname, while thousands of kilometers away, Jalou has to go literally through the trees in an Australian forest.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - Bucket List
programme.desc: Mike’s friend invites him to an Indian wedding And tells him about his uncle who is looking for a luxury condo close to the airport. This client is looking for an investment property And a place for him to live when visiting.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - Right Choice
programme.desc: Daryl And Jin play some golf to discuss a potential listing she has found And Mike aids Inez in purchasing a new vehicle. Daryl’s client has older children with their own families now so they are looking for a home with lots of land And nature.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - Cairns, QLD
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong travels to Cairns, Australia where he embarks on an adventure to the rainforests of Mission Beach. Learning from locals, he learns how to hunt mud crabs with a spear on the traditional fishing grounds of the Kuku Yalanji people.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - Eyre Peninsula, SA
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong travels to the spectacular Eyre Peninsula, South Australia. In shark infested waters he conquers his fears and jumps in to learn how to hunt underwater. From locals he learns how to spear fish and four-wheel drive through sand dunes.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - Sweetness in Nature
programme.desc: This episode demonstrates the diversity and complexity of sweetness and also shows us that nature itself is the greatest brewer, reminding us to return to nature and enjoy the pure sweetness in life.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - Sweetness in the Family
programme.desc: Cakes, maple syrup and taro puree tell a story of inheritance, memory and innovation in different parts of the world. They demonstrate how food can become a symbol of cultural identity and family heritage.

programme.title: Ainsley's Market Menu S1 - Willunga
programme.desc: In a South Australian town, Ainsley gathers rare pork loin for a spicy jerk dish, plus fresh berries and cream for a seasonal market dessert.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - Polar Bears
programme.desc: There is one place in the world where the mighty polar bear—largest carnivore on earth—can be found in large numbers during a very specific time of the year…Churchill Manitoba, Canada.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - Namibia
programme.desc: Bill has a dual quest—the first to visit one of the greatest deserts in the world and find out how the creatures and plants survive. The other is a bit unorthodox and maybe unbelievable – he’s going to seek, and hopefully find, the mythical unicorn.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - Palau And Guam
programme.desc: Exploring the islands of Palau and Guam includes a submarine view of the ocean wildlife, exploration of the battles of World War II, learning the culture of the locals and snorkeling among thousands of jellyfish.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - Lake Titicaca, Peru
programme.desc: The brothers hitch-hike from the ancient Inca capitol of Cuzco, down the spine of the Andes Mountains to Lake Titicaca. They suffer acute mountain sickness, get high on coca leaves and meet some locals as they battle their way across the Andes.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - Luxor, Egypt
programme.desc: The brothers chosen form of transport in Egypt is a Felucca Boat…the ancient trading vessel of transport. They travel north along the Nile, from the oasis town of Aswan to the ancient city of Luxor, before finding a massive sand dune to slide down.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - Abisko, Swedish Lapland
programme.desc: Lapland is a frozen, winterland of reindeer, Sami people and saunas. The brothers start in Stockholm and fly 200 kilometers straight north above the Arctic Circle. Their chosen mode of transport for this journey is a reindeer sleigh.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - Te Whanganui-a-Tara
programme.desc: Piri is joined in his hometown of Wellington by ex Warrior Shontayne Hape, hosting his tamariki and taking them out for a dive and fish targeting the kids favourite - Kina! They also try their hands out at axe throwing at Sweet Axe Wellington.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - Costa Rica
programme.desc: Marilia explores Costa Rica, connecting with nature at Zunya, experiences a cacao ceremony with the Maleku Tribe, and finds wellness in Tamarindo's Cala Luna. At La Senda, she learns to appreciate nature's beauty and the importance of slowing down.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - Ireland
programme.desc: Marilia's Irish journey, meeting land enthusiasts, explored scenic spots, encounters with Ellie and Hazel, vegan delights at Cornucopia, and concluded with a reflective sunset in the Wicklow Mountains, highlighting a strong community spirit.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - Bali
programme.desc: Marilia's Bali journey, focused on purification rituals, blended culture, healing, and adventure. From Tirta Empul's cleansing to exploring Ubud, embracing nature, and local traditions, she found serenity, capturing precious moments in her odyssey.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - Tokyo
programme.desc: Local Exploring in Tokyo is like nothing else. Josh and Lexi Limitless visit the crowded streets, a screaming Monster Café and an abandoned ‘Love Hotel’.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - Nikko
programme.desc: Epic Exploring: Going Local is back in Japan in Nikko as Cody, reunited with Sherman Mak, explores a derelict onsen and an amusement park called Western Village.

programme.title: Rhys Darby in Japan S1 - The Rise of Pabu-chan
programme.desc: The popularity of New Zealand's mascot, Pabu-chan, grows at the Sapporo Snow Festival, and then he gets a chance to hit the big time. Rhys also travels to the Okinawa Islands in search of the beautiful and fleeting cherry blossoms.

programme.title: Access All Areas S1 - Cornwall
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando dives into life in Cornwall to discover the ancient practices of witchcraft and smuggling.

programme.title: Access All Areas S1 - Iceland
programme.desc: Francesca is on a quest to discover why Icelandic people believe in mythical creatures. Is it folk law or are there really trolls lurking in the wilderness?

programme.title: Access All Areas S1 - Snowdonia
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando goes on a high-octane, nail-biting adventure in Snowdonia, one of the remotest corners of the UK.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Alla blir upprymda när de äntligen börjar gräva upp utlovande gröna stenblock som besättningen tror är värda miljoner.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Spänningarna kokar över när de utländska investerarna oväntat kommer förbi för att inspektera arbetet på gruvplatsen Wolverine och Alan försöker skipa fred.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: När de äntligen hittar några lovande stenblock vid Wolverinegruvan, upptäcker teamet att de kan ha brutit mot gruvdriftsreglerna.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Spänningen stiger när slutet av gruvsäsongen närmar sig och teamet i Jade City blir angelägna om att hitta det gäckande stenblocket värt miljontals dollar.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Minusgrader utmanar gruvarbetarna i Jade City som har bråttom för att hitta jackpotten - en jadesten som är tillräckligt stor för att imponera på investerarna - innan säsongen är slut.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia och Robins oprövade maskiner börjar gå sönder på den brutala färden upp till Wolverine-gruvan.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Teamet försöker korsa forsande floder under sin marsch med sina maskiner upp till gruvan, men Josh hamnar på efterkälken i sin problembenägna grävmaskin.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Josh blir strandsatt på den långa leden till Wolverine-gruvan när bultar skakas loss från hans grävmaskin, och han kan inte ringa efter hjälp.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Gruvsäsongen börjar och medan jaden visar sig svårhittad, förvandlas en lastbilsolycka till en lönsam händelse för Jade City.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Guy blir ansvarig för Wolverine, där upplärningen av en ny arbetare hotar att stå i vägen för hans uppdrag att hitta säsongens första jade.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Precis när teamet på Wolverine skärper sina säkerhetsrutiner kollapsar den nya arbetaren Jay, vilket exponerar sprickorna i deras nödberedskap.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Josh blir strandsatt i den nya grävmaskinen samtidigt som ett lager av värdelösa stenar gör att Claudia börjar överväga en ny gruvstrategi.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Alan tar med sig en grupp köpare till Jade City vilket skapar panikläge i Claudias team för att hitta säsongens första säljbara jadeblock.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Medan besättningen kämpar sig genom lera för att hitta ett stenblock som är värt en miljon dollar, riskerar Josh att förlora utrustning för halv miljon dollar när han försöker dra upp sin lastbil ur ett slukhål.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Teamet hittar säsongens bästa jadeblock, men riskerar att minska dess värde när de försöker kapa bort alla frakturer.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudias son Justin visar att han har en näsa för jade, medan Scrappy Larry, Robin och Josh kämpar för att bogsera sin trasiga lastbil upp från spåret till Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: En körning av tillhörigheter tvingar ut Robin och Justin på ett sista försök att leta efter jadestenar för att rädda säsongen medan Scrappy Larry har bråttom för att få en dieseltank ombyggd.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudias satsning på att driva en arbetsgrupp i Jade City hotas när septiktanken backar in i deras dricksvatten.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Med tidig ankomst av det kalla vädret och med skulder som hopar sig, knuffar, släpar och skjuter besättningen på en maffig och potentiellt säsongsvinnande sten till lägret.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Med årets mest lovande stenblock under sågen på Wolverine, kör Josh och R2 i diket med sin lastbil, vilket även drabbar Claudia och teamet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Loppet pågår för att ta sig bort från Wolverine-lägret innan snön täcker allt.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia blir tvungen att köra stenbilen när hennes besättning kämpar sig uppför den steniga stigen till deras bergstoppsbelägna jadeläger, Wolverine

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Spänningarna kulminerar när Claudia, Robin och teamet försöker transportera människor och utrustning till det avlägsna jadelägret.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia och Robin försöker imponera på sina nya affärspartners men de första dagarna på deras nya område, Bullion Creek, är krävande.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Säsongens första stora stenblock transporteras tillbaka till lägret och sätts under sågen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Justin skyndar sig för att inmuta ett område efter att han snubblat över ett fantastiskt jadefynd, men andra gruvarbetare närmar sig.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudias nya partnerskap blir lidande när Justin och teamet distraheras av att försöka flytta ett gigantiskt stenblock som kan vara värt en förmögenhet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Efter att ha hamnat i konflikt med sina affärspartners, tävlar Claudia och Robin om att starta om gruvdriften vid Wolverine, men blir stoppade av ett överraskande hinder.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Teamet kämpar för att få igång Dynastys jadebrott trots bristfällig utrustning.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Justin och Mike kämpar med frakturer och varandra och försöker bevisa sina metoder för otåliga investerare.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Alan återvänder från Kina och ger Justin och Mike en kalldusch av verklighet angående jaden som de håller på att bryta.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Justin och Mike kämpar sig genom snö och fruset vatten för att ta sig fram till det enda potentiellt väldigt värdefulla klippblocket med jade - Big Fin.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Vintern anländer till Dynasty och teamet kämpar med gruvbrytningen fram till allra sista minuten.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia finansierar själv sin stenbrottssäsong och bestämmer sig för att börja jakten på jade en månad tidigare och tvingas ompröva sin strategi när snö och högt vatten stoppar teamet i dess spår.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Robin följer sin intuition till en ny sida på ett gammalt bergsbruksområde, medan Joshs höga förväntningar och korta stubin frestar på Garys tålamod.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Guy kämpar med grävmaskinen för att blotta ett enormt fynd medan Joshs missnöje med sin position i teamet får familjekonflikter att koka över.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Teamet står inför en farlig brytning på stränderna ovanför Turnagainfloden.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Kapandet av ett potentiellt miljonfynd sätts på is när gammal utrustning går sönder.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Kapandet börjar äntligen av den gigantiska jadeskivan vid Dynasty, men stora delar av skivan fraktureras.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Skyfall hotar besättningens säkerhet och stänger av gruvdriften vid grop 3. Josh får en chans att bevisa sina förmågor med grävmaskinen, men ett sammanbrott sätter hans tålamod på prov.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: När en viktig jadeköpare inte blir imponerad av skivan från grop 3, tvingas Claudia fatta ett svårt beslut som gör hennes besättning besviken.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Kapploppet att hinna packa ihop lägret vid Wolverine blir en mardröm när värme, sjukdomar och en skogsbrand sänker sig över besättningen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Den brutala färden till en ny gruvplats leder till att familjen skiljs åt och driver Josh till bristningsgränsen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
programme.desc: Claudia är otålig inför att bryta mark på den nya platsen, men arbetet stoppas av en rad olyckliga incidenter i deras gamla gruvläger, Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | SE
