programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently. It opens with an energetic first movement, followed by a beautiful, slow Andantino based on Schumann’s song ‘Im Herbste’ (1828). The third movement is a short Scherzo. At the request of his future spouse, Clara, the composer replaced the original finale by a less demanding movement. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Boris Berezovsky - Beethoven - Diabelli Variations Op. 120
programme.desc: Music publisher Anton Diabelli spent most of 1819 collecting money to help families that had lost their sons or fathers in the wars. He wrote a theme, hoping 51 leading composers would be willing to write variations to, with the intention of publishing them all as a set. The proceeds would then of course go to the affected families. One of the composers he approached was Ludwig van Beethoven. Initially, the composer did not want to join, but the idea would not leave his mind. The end result is a set of compositions lasting almost an hour.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are works by Arcangelo Corelli, Ludwig van Beethoven, Manuel de Falla, Maurice Ravel, Camille Saint-Saëns, Niccolò Paganini and Antonio Bazzini.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa - Liszt - Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 And 131)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Franz Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Ragna Schirmer - The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann. It records the various places where she lived, and the cities she visited as a pianist. This thought-provoking film was directed by Andreas Morell and Magdalena Zieba-Schwind.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition. She performed as a soloist over the world with the foremost orchestras, and collaborated with acclaimed musicians including Eugène Ysaÿe, George Enescu, and Pablo Casals.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa - Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvořák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, From the New World. Composed during Dvořák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 3, 8 And 11
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 3 in D major, Op. 18 No. 3; String Quartet No. 11 in F minor, Op. 95, “Quartetto Serioso”; and String Quartet No. 8 in E minor, Op. 59, No. 2, Razumovsky. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 23, 2020.

programme.title: Sinfonia Rotterdam, Conrad van Alphen And Alvaro Siviero - Grieg - Piano Concerto, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, recorded in De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2018. Alvaro Siviero is the soloist in Grieg's Piano Concerto No. 1, and closes his performance with 'Dansa do Índio Branco' by Villa-Lobos. Grieg's Piano Concerto, Op. 16, composed in 1868, was the only concerto the composer completed. It is one of his most popular works and is among the most popular of all piano concertos. It is the composer’s earliest important work, written in Søllerød, Denmark, at the age of 24 years old.

programme.title: Coro Infantil Da Universidade de Lisboa, Orquesta Gulbenkian, Coro Gulbenkian And Michel Corboz - Bach - St Matthew Passion, BWV 244
programme.desc: Bach's famous Saint Matthew Passion premiered on Good Friday of 1727 in the St. Thomas Church of Leipzig in Eastern Germany. Since then, it has become essential to the repertoire of Easter compositions. In this 2014 concert from the Grande Auditório Gulbenkian in Lisbon, the Portuguese Gulbenkian Orchestra interprets the work under the baton of Swiss conductor Michel Corboz, accompanied by the wonderful vocalists of the Gulbenkian Choir, and the children's choir Coro Infantil da Universidade de Lisboa. The soloists are Sandrine Piau (soprano), Carlos Mena (counter-tenor), Vincent Lièvre-Picard (evangelist), Christophe Genz (tenor), André Baleiro (Christ) and Peter Harvey (bass).

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería And José Areán - Mahler - Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children. The work's emotional depth comes from its unflinching portrayal of grief through a powerful juxtaposition of natural imagery and intimate parental pain. Audiences are captivated by the work's profound expression of universal human sorrow and the raw, restrained intensity of Mahler's masterful musical depiction of a parent's pain.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Fabio Luisi And Danish National Symphony Orchestra - Stravinsky - Symphony of Psalms
programme.desc: This live performance marks Fabio Luisi’s very first concert with the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in DR Koncerthuset, Copenhagen. Beethoven’s fantastic Eroica symphony is a milestone in classical music, and with Stravinsky’s mighty Symphony of Psalms and Strauss’ virtuosic Don Juan, this production fully demonstrates the unique chemistry between Fabio Luisi and the orchestra of which he today is the celebrated Chief Conductor. This performance was recorded in 2017.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024
programme.desc: Pianist Anthony Ratinov (USA, 1997) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan And Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris - Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale’. Both symphonies saw their premieres in a legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the best-known compositions in western classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often interpreted as the musical manifestation of ’fate knocking at the door’. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Daniel Harding, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino And Christiane Karg - Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart’s swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart’s sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Bolero by Maurice Ravel
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband. This 2017 documentary gives a fascinating account of what happened to one this iconic piece of music right under the nose of the public. Filmmaker Fabien Caux-Lahalle underpins this investigative story with clips of the Boléro in various guises.

programme.title: The Philharmonics - A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky’s tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle, Karen Cargill, London Symphony Orchestra And Gábor Bretz - Berlioz - The Damnation of Faust
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. La damnation de Faust is a work born of the composer’s obsession with Goethe’s legendary tale. Once a righteous scholar, Faust allows himself to be corrupted by the devil, and drags the innocent around him into desperation and death. It’s a fable that defies definition – both a tragedy and dark comedy, with a central character both wise and despicable, and a play and epic poem in one.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst And Cleveland Orchestra - Mozart - Symphony No. 36 'Linz'
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Renowned Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen reflects on his life, artistic vision, and celebrated career. Friends and colleagues share insights alongside excerpts from his groundbreaking ballets.

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir And Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger - Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He’s a pirate/Davy Jones’ from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man’s Chest; ‘Now We Are Free’ from Gladiator; ‘My Heart Will Go On’ from Titanic; and ‘Shallow’ from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: philharmonie zuidnederland, Boris Berezovsky And Dmitri Liss - Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience. He displayed a dialogue with eternity”.

programme.title: The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers. Explore the fusion of arts, science and culture in the 17th and 18th centuries in this imaginative concert commemorating Galileo’s first public demonstration of the telescope. Actor Shaun Smyth narrates a compelling script while the musicians weave in and around a magical stage set by Marshal Pynkoski. Created and scripted by Alison Mackay.

programme.title: Franck - Sonata for violin and piano
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and violinist Maxim Vengerov perform César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press. The conductor's lucidity, efficiency, and lack of pretension, promoted a relaxed collaboration between himself and the orchestra, which is particularly evident in the rehearsal process. This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.

programme.title: Boris Berezovsky, Alexander Sladkovsky And Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra - Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986). This concert was recorded at the Tchaikovksy Concert Hall of the Moscow Philharmonic Society on April 28, 2017.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería And José Areán - Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love. The symphony, built on the composer's personal anguish and existential explorations, is characterized by its deep emotional range, intricate orchestration, and epic scale, culminating in a powerful affirmation of human connection in the face of mortality. Deryck Cook completed a version of the work with the help of materials provided by Mahler's widow.

programme.title: Tim Weiss - Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: This documentary follows the recording of Philip Glass's composition A Descent into the Maelström in Norway's Lofoten Islands and features a rare interview with the composer.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt - Beethoven - Symphony No. 2, Op. 36
programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt leads the Lucerne Festival Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Lithuanian pianist Vadim Chaimovich (*1978) has won several prizes at international piano competitions, such as the Schubert Competition in Dortmund, the William Kapell International Piano Competition in Maryland, and the 29th Masterplayers International Music Competition in Lugano. Moreover, the pianist has performed in several European countries, Japan, and the USA , and has played at many international music festivals. In the current recital, Chaimovich performs piano works by Anton Bruckner. On the program are Klavierstück in E-flat major, WAB 119, Erinnerung in A-flat major, WAB 117, Lancier-Quadrille Nos. 1, 2, 3 And 4 in C major, WAB 120, Steiermärker in G major, WAB 122, Stille Betrachtung an einem Herbstabend ('Quiet meditation on an autumn evening') in F-sharp minor, WAB 123, Fantasie in G major, WAB 118, and Piano sonata in G minor, WAB 243.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 5 in D major, BWV 1050. Remarkably, the harpsichord appears as a solo instrument here, along with the flute and violin, rather than as an accompanying instrument. The piece is therefore considered one of Bach’s very first keyboard concertos.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra And Richard Goode - Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach’s Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven’s famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Iván Fischer - Mozart - Symphony No. 34, KV. 338
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvořák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician. The three-movement symphony features two vibrant outer movements with fanfares and rousing themes, while the quieter second movement is scored for strings alone, deviating from the typical four-movement structure of the time. Next on the program is Dvořák’s Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70, completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák’s broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Vadim Yarkov - Ice Dance: Cinderella 2008
programme.desc: This stunning, new interpretation of Cinderella, is a theatrical ice dancing performance not to be missed.This story of Cinderella focuses on a humble chorus dancer who is thrust into the spotlight, captivates the heart of the most eligible bachelor in town, and despite rival attempts by her stepsisters to steal his heart, shows viewers that true love always triumphs. Recorded in 2008 in Australia by award winning artistic director Tony Mercer, this twist on the classic tale, features the international Imperial Ice Stars, including Albena Denkova and Maxim Staviski, former world champion ice dancers. Original score composed by Tim Duncan and Edward Barnwell.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and others
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of ‘Preludio’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. The program opens with Joseph Haydn’s Concerto in D major for cello and orchestra, H VIIb: 2 (cello and piano reduction), performed by cellist Alejandro Gómez Pareja and pianist Miguel Ángel Ortega Chavaldas. Next, violinist Cecilia Novella Genovés and pianist Alina Artemyeva present Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Souvenir d'un lieu cher, Op. 42, followed by Eugène-Auguste Ysaÿe’s Sonata for solo violin in D minor, Op. 27, No. 3, played by Genovés. Next on the program is Henry Vieuxtemps’s Capriccio, Op. 55, ‘Hommage à Paganini’, presented by violist Mario Carpintero Martín. Bassist Ramsés Martínez Millán and pianist Marharyta Kozlovska close the program with a performance of Johannes Sperger’s Sonata for double bass and viola in D major (in an arrangement for double bass and piano). This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on April 30, 2024.

programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev conducts Rimski-Korsakov
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music. On the program are Suite for Orchestra after the opera 'The Legend of the Invisible City of Kitezh and the Maiden Fevroniya', and Musical Pictures for Orchestra from the opera 'The Tale of Tsar Saltan'. Part of the latter is the famous 'Flight of the Bumblebee'. This concert was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall of the Russian Philharmonic Society in 2017.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods. The work’s title is derived from one of the composer’s favourite authors’ collection of novellas: E. T. A. Hoffmann’s Fantasiestücke in Callots Manier. Like Schumann’s Davidsbündlertänze, his Fantasiestücke are designed as a musical dialogue between Florestan and Eusebius, representing the duality of his own personality. The former represents the composer’s passionate side, and the latter depicts the dreamer in Schumann. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Martinu - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works. The four-movement Concertino was completed in 1933 and saw its first performance in 1936, by the Basler Kammerorchester under the baton of Paul Sacher. During the years 1931-1943, Martin wrote multiple concertante compositions. Many of these works were more or less influenced by the Baroque ‘concerto grosso’ form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble, a principle that appealed to the composer. This performance was recorded at Teatro Bibiena in Mantua, Italy, on January 21, 2016.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer’s unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. Berlioz used one melody in each movement of the work representing the artist’s beloved, an ‘idée fixe’ (a fixed idea or obsession). The work is scored for a large orchestra and features an astonishing array of instrumental colors, including church bells, an off-stage oboe, and strings playing col legno (using the wood of their bow). This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: David Levy - Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S. Bach’s famous The Well-Tempered Clavier (BWV 846-893), a collection of forty-eight preludes and fugues published in two books. A panel member at Leipzig’s Bach competition, Shostakovich was deeply inspired by Russian pianist Tatiana Nikolayeva’s performance of Bach’s 48 Preludes and Fugues. Shostakovich wrote these pieces between the autumn of 1950 and February 1951, dedicating them to Nikolayeva, who agreed to perform the Leningrad premiere in December 1952. David Levy’s performance was recorded at the Budapest Music Center, Hungary, in September 2023.

programme.title: Otto Tausk, Jacquelyn Wagner And Sinfonieorchester St. Gallen - Beethoven - Fidelio, Op. 72
programme.desc: Fidelio (originally titled Leonore, oder Der Triumph der ehelichen Liebe, which translates to Leonore, or the Triumph of Marital Love), Op. 72, is Ludwig van Beethoven's only opera. This 2018 opera film from the Swiss Theater St. Gallen is based on Jan Schmidt-Garre's highly acclaimed stage production of Beethoven's Fidelio. Otto Tausk conducts the Sinfonieorchester and choir of St. Gallen, as well as many wonderful soloists in a beautifully designed set by Nikolaus Webern. The producers carefully filmed and edited several performances, and by using additional footage of starring soloist Jacquelyn Wagner as Leonore, the captivating stage production is enhanced and transformed into a unique cinematic experience.

programme.title: Galaxymphony Strikes Back
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition. She performed as a soloist over the world with the foremost orchestras, and collaborated with acclaimed musicians including Eugène Ysaÿe, George Enescu, and Pablo Casals.

programme.title: Simone Lamsma, Gianandrea Noseda And London Symphony Orchestra - Tchaikovsky – Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek. The composer initially intended to dedicate the piece to the young Kotek, but eventually dedicated it to another violinist, Leopold Auer, as he was afraid of the gossip the dedication would cause. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on April 10, 2022.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna). Schumann composed most of the work during his stay in Vienna in 1839, where he wrote the first four movements, presenting pictures of lively carnival revelry. He completed the fifth, last movement on his return to Leipzig. This piano cycle is among the composer’s most popular. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Alexandre Tharaud - Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 And 111
programme.desc: Beethoven’s last three sonatas – Opus 109, 110 and 111 – explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. At the time of their composition, Beethoven was already locked in himself by his deafness. This deeply affected his relationship to others and to the world. This psychological framework is explored by director Mariano Nante, setting pianist Alexandre Tharaud in a film inspired by the universe of Tarkovski. Filmed in abandoned castles, and lit by director of photography Yorgos Arvanitis, this work evokes solitude and introspection and offers an inner journey through images and music.

programme.title: Iván Fischer And Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino - Mozart Symphony No. 34 And Dvořák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvořák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician. The three-movement symphony features two vibrant outer movements with fanfares and rousing themes, while the quieter second movement is scored for strings alone, deviating from the typical four-movement structure of the time. Next on the program is Dvořák’s Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70, completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák’s broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartet No. 2, Op. 18, No. 2
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons And Oslo Philharmonic - In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide. The Oslo Philharmonic was celebrated for its fresh, open sound and for Jansons’s passionate interpretations of works by Dmitri Shostakovich, Richard Strauss, Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, and Béla Bartók. In this episode of ‘In Rehearsal,’ Jansons guides the orchestra through the powerful Suite from Bartók’s pantomime ballet The Miraculous Mandarin, culminating in a performance at the Oslo Concert Hall.

programme.title: Inna Faliks - Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846

programme.title: Philippe Jordan, Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris, Choeur de l’Opéra national de Paris And Ricarda Merbeth - Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven’s final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. He conducts the Orchestre and Choeurs de l’Opéra national de Paris and four vocal soloists Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Daniela Sindram (mezzosoprano), Robert Dean Smith (tenor), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Beethoven composed his last Symphony when his hearing had all but gone, between 1822 and 1824. Symphony No. 9 is the longest and most ambitious of Beethoven’s symphonies. Most striking is the piece’s finale movement, which includes a choir and four vocal soloists singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller’s poem ‘An die Freude’ (Ode to Joy). This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are works by Arcangelo Corelli, Ludwig van Beethoven, Manuel de Falla, Maurice Ravel, Camille Saint-Saëns, Niccolò Paganini and Antonio Bazzini.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press. The conductor's lucidity, efficiency, and lack of pretension, promoted a relaxed collaboration between himself and the orchestra, which is particularly evident in the rehearsal process. This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.

programme.title: Martha Argerich And Eliane Reyes - Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, pianists Martha Argerich and Khramouchin’s widow Eliane Reyes perform Maurice Ravel’s Ma mère l'Oye. This five-part suite was written for piano four hands.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg And Avery Amereau - Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the Symphony of a Thousand, is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. The work is a unique and grandiose tribute to love and the spiritual salvation of mankind, drawing from two distinct textual sources to create its sublime effect. Audiences most value its overwhelming, ecstatic emotional power and the sheer spectacle of the grand performing forces.

Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Voll zu spät!
programme.desc: In einer dystopischen Vergangenheit angekommen, erkennen Mats und Malika, dass die Stadt von Oberbösewichten beherrscht wird und die Bewohner noch gemeiner sind als zuvor. Nur sie besitzen die Fähigkeit, die Menschen an ihr wahres Ich zu erinnern, um den Faden des Schicksals zu reparieren. Ein mysteriöses Portal im Himmel scheint eine Rolle zu spielen. programme.title: Wild Kat

programme.title: Weihnachtsmann And Co. KG
programme.desc: Die kleine Peggy wird von den anderen Kindern wegen ihrer Nase gehänselt und wünscht sich einen Zauberstab, um ihr Aussehen zu verändern. programme.title: Weihnachtsmann And Co. KG

Trixi und Gilfi finden heraus, dass David den Wunsch hat kleiner zu werden, weil seine Eltern nur noch Augen für seine jüngere Schwester haben. Doch dieser Wunsch kann nur mit einem besonderen Apparat erfüllt werden.

programme.desc: Vanessa und ihr Kameramann Bob geraten bei Dreharbeiten auf der Dino-Insel in eine gefährliche Lage, als sie in einem Baumstamm feststecken und von einem Brachiosaurus in die Höhe gehoben werden. Gemeinsam gelingt es den Hunden, alle Beteiligten sicher vor den prähistorischen Fleischfressern in Sicherheit zu bringen.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Bürgermeister Besserwisser und seine Mutter Helga suchen auf der Dino-Insel Schutz in einem Lava-Tunnel, nachdem ein Dinosaurier für Chaos gesorgt und den Eingang mit Felsbrocken versperrt hat. Während Helga den verletzten Saurier versorgt, befreit die PAW Patrol die Kätzchen aus einer Teer-Grube. Abschließend gelingt es Ryder und den Hunden, die Besserwissers und den Dinosaurier kurz vor einem Lavastrom aus der Höhle zu retten.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Ryder hat eine Überraschung für die Fellfreunde. Gemeinsam mit Rex besuchen sie die Dino-Wildnis. Bürgermeister Besserwisser, der ihnen heimlich folgt, sorgt natürlich wieder für Chaos. Er stiehlt den Dinosaurier-Müttern ihre Eier. Er will mit einem Dinosaurier-Park viele Besucher in die Nachbarstadt locken. Die Dino-Mütter richten aus Sorge um ihren Nachwuchs, großen Schaden an. Wie gut, dass die Paw Patrol gerade dort ist, um zu helfen.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: In der Dino-Wildnis ist ein tollkühner Flugsaurier auf einen Felsvorsprung abgestürzt. Die Paw Patrol muss seinen eingeklemmten Flügel von Felsbrocken befreien und den Saurier von dem Vorsprung herunterholen.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Bei einem Vulkanausbruch ruft Dr. Tollpatsch die PAW Patrol zu Hilfe, um einer Dinosaurier-Herde zu helfen, die von der Lava bedroht wird. Ein T-Rex hat es nicht rechtzeitig geschafft und steckt fest, aber die PAW Patrol findet eine Lösung.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Die Paw Patrol will Rex in der Dino - Wildnis besuchen. Bei der Gelegenheit wollen sie sein Hundehaus reparieren, das zusammengestürzt ist, nachdem ein Triceratops sich darin breitgemacht hat. Unterdessen lädt Bürgermeister Besserwisser alle zur Eröffnung seiner neuesten Attraktion in der Nachbarstadt ein: Der Besserwisser-Dino-Safari.

programme.title: Paw Patrol

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Käpt'n Tollpatsch und Francois schließen sich Ryder und den Fellfreunden an, um einen Ausflug in die Dino-Wilnis zu machen. Ihr Ziel ist es, ihre Familie zu besuchen. Während des Ausflugs erleben sie viele Abenteuer und Herausforderungen.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: In der 13. Staffel der Paw Patrol begleiten wir die Fellfreunde auf spannende neue Missionen. Ob Luftabenteuer oder dramatische Rettungsaktionen in der Abenteuerbucht - neue Freunde und spannende Rettungseinsätze stehen auf dem Programm.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Julia, Julius und Bürgermeisterin Gutherz erkunden gemeinsam mit Ryder und der Paw Patrol die Dino-Insel. Dort treffen sie den Experten Rex und seinen Freund Timmy. Während der Entdeckungstour geraten die Bürgermeisterin und die Zwillinge in Treibsand, während eine Parasaurolophus-Herde das Huhn Henrietta entführt. Die Paw Patrol startet einen Rettungseinsatz, um die Gruppe zu befreien und die in Panik geratenen Dinosaurier zu schützen.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Bürgermeister Besserwisser nutzt ein Hai-U-Boot und einen Dino-Duplikator, um mit Roboter-Dinosauriern die Kontrolle über die Dino-Insel zu übernehmen. Die Paw Patrol rettet den verschwundenen Timmy und kämpft gegen die künstlichen Dino-Doppelgänger. Durch den gemeinsamen Einsatz von Rex und der Paw Patrol wird der Duplikator deaktiviert und die Insel vor der Zerstörung bewahrt.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Digi und Tal installieren im Auftrag von Rex Wildkameras auf der Dinosaurierinsel, um die Sicherheit der Tiere zu gewährleisten. Da sie Verletzungen durch stachelige Schwänze befürchten, stecken sie Fußbälle auf die Stacheln, was die Dinosaurier verärgert. Rex, Ryder und die Paw Patrol eilen zur Hilfe. Währenddessen verschließen die Roboter den brodelnden Vulkan mit einem Stöpsel, was die Gefahr eines Ausbruchs massiv erhöht.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Danny X bringt dem T-Rex Timmy das Skateboardfahren bei, während Ryder und die Hunde das beschädigte Board reparieren. Bei der Beobachtung von Archaeopteryxen schwingt sich Danny in einen Fluganzug, um einen Stunt zu wagen. Die Vögel nehmen ihn in ihre Gruppe auf, doch ein Zusammenstoß mit einem stacheligen Saurier beschädigt den Anzug. Skye und Zuma müssen den verunglückten Danny sowie einen abstürzenden Archaeopteryx retten.

programme.title: På spåret - syntolkat
programme.desc: Johan Hurtig och Johanna Wagrell möter Amy Deasismont och Uje Brandelius i den första matchen i grupp 4 i Sveriges mest populära frågesportprogram. Kristian Luuk är programledare och Fredrik Lindström domare. Husband: Cleo And Ayla. Gästartist: Fricky.

programme.title: Skärgårdsdoktorn - syntolkat
programme.desc: Anja och Martin Blom återvänder från Kina med sitt lilla adoptivbarn. Wilma känner sig bortglömd av Maddo, och vilka är egentligen Krilles avsikter?

programme.title: De svenska supermodellerna - teckenspråkstolkat
programme.desc: Anna Klevhag går en av 90-talets mest omtalade visningar och Izabella Scorupco blir firad Bondbrud - men berättar också om den tuffa tiden efter succén. Mini Andén minns när Tyra Banks tog hennes outfit och Marcus Schenkenberg berättar om filmrollen som gick förlorad efter en blöt natt. Heroin chic och mordet på en modedesigner signalerar slutet för supermodell-eran. Från brittiska gods till New York och Nashville: hur ser livet ut efter åren i strålkastarljuset?

programme.title: Gift vid första ögonkastet XL - syntolkat
programme.desc: Stämningen är allt annat än på topp efter en skakig parmiddag. Sofia har funderingar kring relationen med Rasmus och vänder sig till Olivia för råd. Under en dramatisk löftesceremoni kommer saker upp till ytan - och kvällen tar en oväntad vändning för två av paren.

programme.title: Sveriges nästa stjärnkock - New York
programme.desc: Att bli stjärnkock handlar om mer än att laga mat - du måste också kunna sälja dig själv. Marcus skickar därför kockarna till en brandingexpert, där de ställs mot varandra i en ny tävling. På Barbuto fortsätter Ruba att kämpa med den frostiga relationen till köksmästaren Waxman. Samtidigt pressas Frank till bristningsgränsen på restaurang Askas tvåstjärniga kök. När han inte lyckas hålla tyst får han ta konsekvenserna - i kylrummet, med pannlampa.

programme.title: 1% Klubben- teckenspråkstolkat
programme.desc: I detta avsnitt ställs deltagarna bland annat inför frågan: Om fem plankor har tio ändar, hur många ändar finns det då på sju och en halv planka? Vet du svaret? Vem tar sig hela vägen till den avgörande 1%-frågan? 100 tävlande sätts på prov i logik och problemlösning när frågorna blir svårare och svårare. Hur långt hade du klarat dig? Programledare: Johan Petersson.

programme.title: Agent-ish - teckenspråkstolkat
programme.desc: Värsta grejen! Idag skulle jag sitta i rullstol och låtsas vara döv! You gotta be kiddin'! Gunilla och Max vill att Provision ska framstå som bästa firman med parasportfokus. Svårt, och rätt ovärdigt att försöka lura Aron Anderson!

programme.title: Per och Marie – historien om Roxette
programme.desc: Marie Fredriksson från Östra Ljungby och Per Gessle från Halmstad träffas i musikkretsar under tidigt 80-tal. När Pers karriär efter Gyllene Tider börjar dala börjar Maries solostjärna stiga - och mot alla odds gör de en låt tillsammans som faktiskt blir en hit: Neverending Love 1986. Genom deras egna filmer får vi följa med från första singeln fram till att deras stora genombrott med The Look står för dörren.

programme.title: Spelet - syntolkat
programme.desc: Svitens mäktiga gudfader fortsätter hålla spelet i sitt grepp, men det börjar brännas under fötterna. När Kuben förklarar att den som elimineras kommer dra med sig en annan spelare i fallet ändras allt. Spelarna måste tänka i flera dimensioner inför utröstningen.

programme.title: Luksusfælden
programme.desc: Cathrine på 24 og Kasper på 27 bor i en lejelejlighed i Hornslet på det sydlige Djursland. Sammen har de sønnen Noah på et halvt år. Kasper har lige skiftet job og kender endnu ikke sin nøjagtige løn, mens Cathrine går hjemme på barselsdagpenge med deres lille søn.

programme.title: Luksusfælden
programme.desc: Shela og Jan har været kærester i snart fire år, og i al den tid de har kendt hinanden, har de levet over evne. De skylder knap 300.000 kroner i ren forbrugsgæld. De er nu kommet så langt ud, at de ikke har råd til at betale alle deres regninger.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen
programme.desc: Linse får den ide, at hun vil til England med Mor Ann. Men det er ikke så let, som det lyder. Mor Ann har ikke været ude af Danmark i mere end 30 år, og hendes engelske pas er udløbet. Mor Ann møder modstand, da hun prøver at få passet fornyet, og derfor beslutter hun sig for at blive dansk statsborger.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen
programme.desc: Linse kæmper fortsat for at ændre hundeloven. Hun har lavet en protestsang, og sammen med Stephanie skal hun lægge sidste hånd på den sammen med en håndfuld gode venner, der skal synge kor. Der skal også laves en musikvideo til Linses hundesang, og selvom det handler om hunde, så skal der være lidt Lækker-Linse i den.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen
programme.desc: Mor Ann får sit engelske pas helt uventet, og det betyder, at hun kan tage til England for at vise sin barndomsegn til Linse. Stephanie skal ikke med til England, og derfor overrasker Mor Ann sit barnebarn med en tur på engelsk pub, hvor Stephanie skal smage på engelske specialiteter. Lebbe-Lone fylder 50, og derfor tager Linse og Stephanie hende med ud på en tur i amerikanerbil, og det bliver ikke en kedelig køretur. Det er det heller ikke, da Linse og Mor Ann sejler til England fra Esbjerg. Det er en voldsom storm, og den er ikke sjov for Linse, der har det med at blive søsyg. Hjemme på Bryggen foreviger Stephanie sin kærlighed til Michal ved at få taget parbilleder.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen
programme.desc: Linse får et gammelt og stort ønske opfyldt. Hun er med Mor Ann i England for at se, hvor hendes mor er vokset op. Det bliver følelsesladet tur for begge.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Janni Re drømmer om at blive økonomisk uafhængig af Karsten. Hun tager derfor med sit nye vinfirma til Næsbyholm Slot, hvor hun, til en storslået middag, vil prøve at imponere en række særligt inviterede indkøbere. Tina Lund skal se det nye sommerhus, som hun og manden Allan Nielsen er ved at få bygget, og så kommer der masser af snøft og tårer, da hun skal vise sin nye datter frem til moderen for første gang.

programme.title: Med Kniven for Struben
programme.desc: I Vejle er stemningen på nulpunktet. Heini og Marianas drøm om et argentinsk spisehus er begyndt at briste. Heini er nedlagt med sygdom, og Mariana kan ikke klare arbejdet i restauranten selv.

programme.title: Med Kniven for Struben
programme.desc: Caféen i Aalborg kører slet ikke rundt. En forretning udelukkende baseret på billige deal-gæster, truer med at slå bunden ud af det unge forpagter-pars økonomi. Lykkedes det for Thomas Castberg at få dem til at indse, at de er på katastrofekurs, før det er for sent?

programme.title: Luksusfælden
programme.desc: I Faxe bor Natasja, der er enlig mor. Hun har haft en turbulent barndom og har ingen anelse om, hvordan hun skal håndtere sin økonomi. I stedet optager hun stribevis af lån og bruger alt, hvad hun har, på skønhedsbehandlinger, tøj og extensions. I virkeligheden drømmer Natasja om at give sin søn en stabil fremtid og have styr på sit liv. Men før Natasja kan det, kræver det, at hun finder ud af, hvorfor hun har behov for hele tiden at forskønne sit ydre. Kan Luksusfældens eksperter hjælpe hende?

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: De tre politifolk, Natalie, Dylan og Alex har til mission at bringe et stjålet apparat tilbage, før det kan tilintetgøre menneskeligheden. Dog trues deres planer af den stumme men dødsensfarlige Thin Man.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker forsøger at manøvrere i sit “andet liv” som den elskede Spider-Man. Lykkelig over sin seneste mission med The Avengers, vender han hjem – dog under konstant overvågning fra sin nye mentor; Tony Stark. Peter forsøger at falde tilbage i den normale, daglige rutine, men distraheres af sine tanker om at ville bevise sit værd, og at han er mere end bare den hjælpsomme Spider-Man. Men da Vulture dukker op som en ny trussel, er alt hvad Peter holder af pludselig i fare.

programme.title: Wonder Woman
programme.desc: Inden hun blev til Wonder Woman, var hun amazone-prinsessen Diana der var trænet til at være en uovervindelig kriger. Hun vokser op på en beskyttet paradisisk ø og da en amerikansk pilot styrter ned på øens kyst, fortæller han hende om en massiv konflikt der udspiller sig i verden udenfor, og Diana forlader sit hjem i den tro at hun kan standse truslen.

programme.desc: Det er bestemt ikke blevet nemmere at være for lækker til love. Gustav, Christina, Ciano og alle de andre leder stadig efter den eneste ene. Gustav har givet op på de københavnske mænd og efter råd fra en terapeut, leder han nu efter en rolig landmand med pengepungen i orden. Derfor er næste stop Århus. Anders’ gode ven har sat ham op med en date. Og det er ikke en hvilken som helst date. Det er nemlig en dobbeltdate med et sæt tvillinger, som Anders har helt for sig selv.

programme.title: Tattoo Salonen
programme.desc: Der er fart på, når vi åbner op for en ny sæson af Tattoo Salonen. Imens det kulørte personale i København fortsat har travlt med at opfylde kundernes blækfyldte drømme, så er Mortens drøm om at blive tattoobranchens svar på Joe and the Juice godt i gang.

programme.title: Tattoo Salonen
programme.desc: Hannah har rund fødselsdag og alle i København er opsat på, at give hende en helt særlig dag med gaver og surprise! I Odense skal Jacob tatovere sin ømskindede far og det ser han som en kærkommen mulighed for at drille lidt.

programme.title: Tattoo Salonen
programme.desc: Der spænding i luften, når Morten og Hannah skal hente deres helt nye au pair i lufthavnen. Christian får sig en noget anderledes kunde, da den kristne Ponyboy kommer ind i salonen. Ponyboy er en såkaldt Bronie og passioneret fan af My Little Pony.

programme.title: Koch'en på toppen
programme.desc: Jesper og personalet får nok at se til, når Alsik Hotel slår dørene op for glamourøse og eksklusive gæster fra velgørenhedsarrangementet Cool Car Race. Peter kæmper med at skabe den perfekte kartoffelret i Michelin-restauranten Syttende, og hos familien Koch kommer der tårer i øjenkrogen, da Mikkel skal til sin sidste eksamen.

programme.title: Koch'en på toppen
programme.desc: Intet er overladt til tilfældighederne, når Alsik Hotel danner ramme om verdens største klimakonference, og med både prominente gæster og royalt besøg, kommer det til at kræve en ekstra indsats fra alle mand. På Syttende skal Jesper og personalet præstere i helt uvante rammer, når Michelin-restauranten rykker deres eksklusive kogekunst til Sønderborg Slot.

programme.title: Koch'en på toppen
programme.desc: Jesper og kollegaerne sætter alle sejl ind på at give gæsterne en ekstraordinær oplevelse, når årets hidtil største event, Tour de France, kommer til byen. Der er fuldt booket på det travle hotel, og for personalet kræver det hårdt arbejde, hvis de skal nå i mål med dagens arrangement. Jesper tager også fusen på sønnen Mikkel, når hele familien Koch tager til dimension.

programme.title: Koch'en på toppen
programme.desc: Jesper får sved på panden til Danmarks største food festival, når hundredvis af madglade fans dukker op for at smage på hotellets delikatesser. Anne får brug for det store overblik, når hun og kollegaerne afholder en storstilet rekrutteringsworkshop for at hyre nye medarbejdere til både hotellet og det nye spillested. Hjemme hos familien Koch sætter Jesper og Mikkel alle sejl til for at holde et studentergilde, som ingen vil glemme.

programme.title: Koch'en på toppen
programme.desc: Jesper får besøg hele vejen fra Italien, og så tager han og Peter speedbåden til en lille sønderjysk ø for at opleve nogle sjældne køer på dansk jord. Imens knokler Anne og Joy på Sergenten for at blive klar til sæsonens første dinnershow. Det er lettere sagt end gjort, for alt personalet er nyansatte, der aldrig før har prøvet at afvikle et storstilet Alsik-arrangement. Da det store slag skal slås, træder Jesper selv til i køkkenet, og det bliver en aften, de sent vil glemme.

programme.title: Koch'en på toppen
programme.desc: Jesper får besøg af vennerne fra Masterchef til en festlig gourmetdag i køkkenet på Alsik Hotel. De fire kokke kæmper om at dupere de kræsne gæsters ganer og nyder hinandens selskab imens. Joy bliver stewardesse for en dag, da hun serverer delikatesser fra Restaurant Syttende på flyet fra København til Sønderborg, og Jesper og Peter får jord under neglene, da de tager på tur til en ny, spændende, sønderjysk leverandør.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: De tre politifolk, Natalie, Dylan og Alex har til mission at bringe et stjålet apparat tilbage, før det kan tilintetgøre menneskeligheden. Dog trues deres planer af den stumme men dødsensfarlige Thin Man.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker forsøger at manøvrere i sit “andet liv” som den elskede Spider-Man. Lykkelig over sin seneste mission med The Avengers, vender han hjem – dog under konstant overvågning fra sin nye mentor; Tony Stark. Peter forsøger at falde tilbage i den normale, daglige rutine, men distraheres af sine tanker om at ville bevise sit værd, og at han er mere end bare den hjælpsomme Spider-Man. Men da Vulture dukker op som en ny trussel, er alt hvad Peter holder af pludselig i fare.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: Lise glemmer Martins fødselsdag, og stemningen er anspændt. Redaktionen tvivler på hendes idé om Johannes, men inviterer ham til en prøve, da han er kok. Fødselsdagen går ikke som planlagt.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: Johannes er programmets nye kok, og redaktionens tiltag virker. En DNA-test tyder på, at Lise har ukendt familie. Hun prøver at tale med Martin. Johannes lokkes med til festen og er god til at lytte.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far from Home
programme.desc: Efter Avengers seneste kamp tager Peter på ferie i Europa, i håb om at få nogle ugers pause fra superheltelivet. Men snart må han hjælpe Nick Fury med at stoppe et angreb fra mystiske element-væsener.

programme.title: Ghost Rider
programme.desc: Nogle gange kan man ønske sig noget så brændende, at man er villig til at indgå en pagt med Djævelen for at opnå det. Ønsket kan være grådighed – efter magt, penge, ære og anden jordisk glans. Men man kan også være villig til at sælge sin sjæl for at redde dem, man holder af. Djævelen er sådan set ligeglad så længe man underskriver sin kontrakt med blod.

programme.title: Jackpot!
programme.desc: I en nær fremtid er der blevet oprettet et 'Grand-lotteri' i Californien - hagen: Det gælder om at slå vinderen ihjel inden solnedgang for at gøre lovligt krav på jackpotten på flere milliarder dollars. Da Katie Kim (Awkwafina) flytter til Los Angeles, får hun ved en fejl vinderkuponen. Desperat efter at overleve horderne af jackpotjægere slår hun sig modvilligt sammen med amatørlotteribeskyttelsesagenten Noel Cassidy (John Cena), som vil gøre alt i sin magt for at få hende til solnedgang i bytte for en del af hendes præmie. Noel må dog kæmpe mod sin smarte rival Louis Lewis (Simu Liu), som også vil have fat i Katies provision for enhver pris.

programme.title: For Lækker til Love
programme.desc: Gustav er blevet rådet til at udvide sin horisont, og leder derfor efter kærligheden i Århus. Her kan han næsten ikke tro sit eget held, da han finder en velhavende entreprenør.

programme.title: Sommer i Magaluf
programme.desc: I Sommer i Magaluf følger vi unge danskere en uforglemmelig sommer på Mallorca. Destinationschefen Nikolaj Hvidmand og hans kæreste Anne Plejdrup sikrer at alle gæster får deres livs festligeste uge.

programme.title: Stumble
programme.desc: Skolen starter igen, og ud over træningen skal Courteney også have sine elever godt på plads på kollegiet.

programme.title: Koch'en på toppen
